source.name: TCGA · Cholangiocarcinoma
source.citation: The Cancer Genome Atlas, PanCancer Atlas (Cell, 2018); cBioPortal Datahub.
source.data_terms: ODbL-1.0 for the adapted database; retain the upstream TCGA study notice and attribution.
source.expression_units: RSEM normalized abundance, upstream batch normalized, linear scale
transformations: Exact sample intersection across all assay coverage sources
Exclude all missing/ambiguous symbol or Entrez rows; no arbitrary duplicate selection
Preserve source consequence classes including synonymous/noncoding records
Purity and batch not reported in selected source fields; retain missing explicitly
limitations: Processed tables only; sequencing read QC and variant calling were not rerun
36 tumors from one study; no normal comparator or external validation cohort
PCA and mutation/CNA summaries are descriptive; no diagnostic classifier or survival model is fitted
Variant counts include all source consequence classes and are not TMB per megabase

validation.scope: Tabular contract validation; assay-level sequencing quality is not inferred from processed tables

analysis.pca_scope: Fixed full-cohort coordinates; filtering selects points without refitting PCA

summary.qc_rate_scope: Assessable cohort checks only; unavailable fields are listed separately
